title: Dev Studio
description: HTML files as cards; Dev Studio edits a page the way Figma edits a frame
description_ru: HTML-файлы карточками; Dev Studio правит страницу, как Figma правит фрейм
about: HTML files of the library as cards on the Hyimg canvas, a live sandboxed page when big on screen; Dev Studio: the page's DOM tree, the live page and an inspector of the selected element; it edits the file in place: colours, fill, stroke, corners, type, opacity, padding, size and text, a :root variable for this element or everywhere, undo with ⌘Z; Edit mode (E): the HTML edited as in a browser's inspector, tags, attributes, text and elements, each change written into the file in place, History of the session's writes
